## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Privacy and source preservation

- [ ] Conversion remains local inside Obsidian.
- [ ] The clipboard remains the output of the copy workflow.
- [ ] Note files remain unchanged during copying.
- [ ] User content is preserved by default, or the transformation is explicitly opt-in.
- [ ] Logs and fixtures use synthetic content.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated regression tests.
- [ ] I ran npm run check.
- [ ] I updated README or compatibility documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I tested the affected destination in the real application, or clearly marked that testing as pending.
